question: Which natural form of vitamin B helps to prevent some of the major birth defects of the baby's brain (anencephaly) and spina bifida?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Folate**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Folate** (vitamin B9) **is the natural form of vitamin B that can help prevent birth defects **like anencephaly and spina bifida: 
 
• **Folic acid can reduce the risk **of neural tube defects (NTDs), which include anencephaly and spina bifida, by more than 70%.
 
• NTDs occur when the spinal cord doesn't close properly. 
 
• The **CDC recommends that all women of reproductive age take 400 micrograms (mcg) of folic acid daily before and during early pregnancy. **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Anencephaly **is a** serious birth defect where parts of the baby's brain and skull don't form properly, **and babies born with it cannot survive.

 
 
• The upper part of the neural tube does not close fully during early embryonic development.
 
• Adequate intake of folic acid before and during early pregnancy can reduce the risk.
 
 
 
• Spina bifida is another serious birth defect where the baby's spine doesn't develop correctly, which can lead to severe physical disabilities.
 
 
• It can range from mild (occulta, often asymptomatic) to severe forms (myelomeningocele, involving nerve damage and disabilities such as paralysis or bladder/bowel dysfunction).
